title: Chat backend

milestones.title: [P4.1] Chat backend: persistent messaging over the supplied WebSocket scaffold
milestones.focus: Persisted messaging on a transport scaffold
milestones.task: Fill in the Chat store behind serve_chat.py. Keep connection framing out of the milestone: the prepared harness implements the handshake and bounded masked text frames. Commit the room sequence and message together before returning the sequence.
milestones.failureInjection: An acknowledgement sent before commit can lose a message after the sender stops retrying. A retry must return the existing sequence for identical content, while changed content under the same key conflicts.
milestones.evidence: Send two messages, retry one, restart the store, and observe exactly two sequences in order.
milestones.testCommand: py -3 -m unittest discover -s projects/tests -p test_projects.py -k P4_1 -v
milestones.stopCondition: Stop when the focused deterministic test passes and the stated evidence is recorded. Extensions are separate practice.

milestones.title: [P4.2] Chat backend: reconnect cursors, offline delivery, and tests
milestones.task: Implement a bounded keyset query using room and seq > cursor. Disable the hub for one committed message, reconnect from the last acknowledged sequence, and retrieve the missed item from storage.
milestones.failureInjection: Presence or socket connection status cannot prove delivery. Cursor advancement should occur after the client applies a message, with deduplication by room and sequence.
milestones.evidence: Show a missing live notification followed by successful cursor recovery with no fabricated delivery guarantee.
milestones.testCommand: py -3 -m unittest discover -s projects/tests -p test_projects.py -k P4_2 -v
milestones.stopCondition: Stop when the focused deterministic test passes and the stated evidence is recorded. Extensions are separate practice.

milestones.title: [P4.3] Chat backend: multiple workers, pub/sub, and presence expiry
milestones.task: Create two worker objects sharing the same database and hub. Submit twenty messages concurrently and verify sequence uniqueness. Add heartbeat leases and remove stale presence at an exact fake-clock boundary.
milestones.failureInjection: Generating sequence numbers outside the append transaction creates duplicates or gaps caused by conflicting writers. Presence is eventually accurate and may remain visible until TTL expires.
milestones.evidence: Observe sequences 1 through 20 exactly once, plus online→offline after a ten-second heartbeat expiry.
milestones.testCommand: py -3 -m unittest discover -s projects/tests -p test_projects.py -k P4_3 -v
milestones.stopCondition: Stop when the focused deterministic test passes and the stated evidence is recorded. Extensions are separate practice.

milestones.title: [P4.4] Chat backend: load, disconnect, authorization, and recovery tests
milestones.task: Test unauthorized send and read, conflicting retry payloads, and transport reconnect. The server determines sender identity from its validated demo token, not a user field in the JSON payload. State the production changes needed before exposure beyond loopback.
milestones.failureInjection: Never trust a supplied room cursor or user name as authorization. Repeat membership checks on each command and use the stored identity throughout.
milestones.evidence: Provide a denied read/write transcript, a real WebSocket reconnect test, and a recovery explanation grounded in the persistent log.
milestones.testCommand: py -3 -m unittest discover -s projects/tests -p test_projects.py -k P4_4 -v
milestones.stopCondition: Stop when the focused deterministic test passes and the stated evidence is recorded. Extensions are separate practice.

baselineArtifact: Persistent messages, reconnect cursors, multiple workers
authorship: original prepared teaching implementation; curriculum names and milestone IDs source-derived
invariant: Authorized messages commit before acknowledgement and have a monotonically increasing sequence within each room. Live delivery is a hint; a cursor can recover committed messages.
requirements: Persist room membership, ordered message log, and sender-scoped idempotency keys.
Support reconnect via seq > cursor, independently of lost pub/sub notifications.
Use separate DB connections for concurrent workers and expiring presence that never grants authorization.
architecture: authenticated demo WebSocket → membership check → SQL append with room sequence → acknowledgement; live notification hints → reconnect query against authoritative log.
limitations: The supplied stdlib WebSocket scaffold supports bounded unfragmented text frames, ping/pong and close. Demo tokens are local test identities, not a production identity provider. Hub is an in-process lossy pub/sub stand-in shared by worker objects, not a multi-host broker.
extensions: Replace the Hub simulator with a broker adapter while retaining cursor recovery tests.
Add read-receipt semantics distinct from delivery acknowledgement and user presence.
referenceReveal: Explicit reveal in the academy; reference source also remains inspectable on disk. Educational spoiler control, not secure examination.
